description: Source code for the AAudioServiceEndpoint class, managing audio stream endpoints, including registration, disconnection, and configuration matching in the Android AAudio framework.

classes.name: AAudioServiceEndpoint
classes.description: Manages audio stream endpoints, including registration, disconnection, and configuration matching.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string with detailed information about the endpoint's current state and registered streams.

methods.name: isStreamRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a stream with a specific port handle is registered.

methods.name: disconnectRegisteredStreams
methods.description: Disconnects all registered streams and returns them.

methods.name: releaseRegisteredStreams
methods.description: Disconnects and closes all registered streams.

methods.name: registerStream
methods.description: Registers a new stream with the endpoint.

methods.name: unregisterStream
methods.description: Unregisters a stream from the endpoint.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint matches a given stream configuration.

methods.name: getAudioAttributesFrom
methods.description: Creates audio attributes from stream parameters.
